subject.title: Aumentar el nº páginas (productos) a mostrar en catálogo ecommerce

question: Should the public ecommerce catalog expand to a 30,000-product pagination window for SEO now, or should BL-ecommerce-catalog keep the current 500-result window and lower the API cap?
rationale: Both directions are represented by open issues, and the 30,000-product path has SEO, latency, cost, and BL-spec implications that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Confirm 30,000 SEO phase
options.body: Implement the coordinated cap increase and retarget or close the conflicting BL issue so the product direction is unambiguous.

options.title: Keep the 500-result window
options.body: Treat this request as superseded by the BL catalog cap work and update this issue with the SEO tradeoff.

options.title: Defer to BL F2 validation
options.body: Pause implementation until the BL-ecommerce-catalog owner validates the pagination rule and monitoring requirements.

recommendation.title: Confirm 30,000 SEO phase
recommendation.body: Implement the coordinated cap increase and retarget or close the conflicting BL issue so the product direction is unambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: The BL catalog parent issue identifies this handle as owner, and the conflicting cap issue was created from that validation path.
